question: Nazir can wash his car 15 minutes while his son takes twice as long. If they work together how many minutes will the job take them?
explanation:
🔖His son can wash the car in (15 × 2 = 30) minutes
Nazir can wash 1/15 part of the car in 1 minute
His son can wash 1/30 part of the can in 1 minute
Together they can wash (1/15+1/30=1/10) part of the car in 1 minute
So, together they can wash the whole car in 10 minutes.

question: A batsman in his 17th innings makes a score of 85 and thereby increases his average by 3, his average after the 17th innings is :
explanation:
🔖Let the average of the first 16 innings be A.
Total of the 16 innings = 16A
New average = A+3
New total of 17 innings, 17(A+3) = 16A+85
or, 17A+51=16A+85
or, 17A-16A=85-51
or, A = 34
So, new average after 17th innings = A+3 = 34+3 = 37

question: Two pipes A & B would fill a tank in 20 & 30 minutes respectively. Both pipes being open, find when A must be turned off so that tank may be just filled in 15 minutes.
explanation:
🔖Let the time be T minutes after which pipe A need to turned off. Both of the pipes remain open together only for T minutes.
Pipe A fills 1/20 of the tank in 1 minute.
Pipe B fills 1/30 of the tank in 1 minute
Together in 1 minute they fill (1/20+1/30=1/12) of the tank.
Together in T minutes they fill = T/12 of the tank
In (15-T) minutes, pipe B alone can fill = (15-T)/30 of the tank
Now, T/12 + (15-T)/30 = 1
or, {15T + 6(15-T)}/180 = 1
or, (15T + 90 - 6T) / 180 = 1
or, 9T = 180 - 90
or, 9T = 90
So, T = 10 minutes

question: What percentage of profit is made by selling an article at a certain price if by selling at two third of that price there would be a loss of 20%?
explanation:
🔖Let the cost price and sell price be A and S respectively.
ATQ, (A - 2S/3) /A = 20/100
or, (A - 2S/3) / A = 1/5
or, (A - 2S/3) = A/5
or, 2S/3 = A - A/5
or, 2S/3 = 4A/5
or, S = 4A/5 × 3/2
or, S = 6A/5
Now, profit = (S - A) / A × 100%
= (6A/5 - A) / A × 100%
= (A/5) / A × 100%
= 20%

question: Divide Rs. 5625 among A, B & C so that A may receive 1/2 as much as B & C and B 1/4 of what A and C together receive?
explanation:
🔖Let they receive A, B & C Rs. respectively.
Now, A = (B + C) / 2
or, 2A = B + C ----------(i)
Again, B = (A + C) / 4
or, 4B = (A + C)
or, 4B = (B + C) / 2 + C
or, 4B = B/2 + C/2 + C
or, 4B - B/2 = 3C/2
or, 7B/2 = 3C/2
or, B = 3C/7-------(ii)
Now, 2A = 3C/7 + C [from (i)]
or, 2A = 10C/7
or, A = 5C/7------(iii)
From (ii) and (iii),
B : C = 3 : 7
C : A = 7 : 5
So, A : B : C = 5 : 3 : 7
A will receive = 5 / (5 + 3 + 7) × 5625 = 1875 Rs.
B will receive = 3 / (5 + 3 + 7) × 5625 = 1125 Rs.
C will receive = 7 / (5 + 3 + 7) × 5625 = 2625 Rs.

Total travelled = 100 + 60 + 80 = 240 miles
Average rate = 240 / 15 = 16 miles per hour
